mysql --batch --raw --column-names --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --host gateway02.us-east-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com --port 4000 --user 3ND3mF15qH8onZj.root --database H2pjHHJbH276XmnbNcJhCp --execute 
-- Cannabis Indica (ghost_variety_id = 4) avec Myrcène
SELECT gvml.molecule_id, gvml.link_type, gvml.percentage, m.name 
FROM ghost_variety_molecule_links gvml 
JOIN molecules m ON gvml.molecule_id = m.id 
WHERE gvml.ghost_variety_id = 4 
ORDER BY CAST(gvml.percentage AS DECIMAL) DESC LIMIT 5;

-- Vérifier molecule_origins
SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM molecule_origins LIMIT 1;

-- Vérifier IFRA restrictions pour Géraniol (ID 1710039) et Citronellol
SELECT COUNT(*) as ifra_count FROM ifra_restrictions WHERE molecule_id IN (1710039);
